units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|Thanks to the planet's high gravity, Burthen is not a common destination, but today the spaceport seems to have a lot of visitors. Many of the usually empty landing pads are occupied, and you notice a sizable crowd at the edge of the spaceport as you step out onto its rather untarnished apron. Some members of the crowd are obviously from offworld judging by their height, and there's even a few media crews standing by, although it looks like their camera drones are struggling with Burthen's gravity.|723|0
units.english: Thanks to the planet's high gravity, Burthen is not a common destination, but today the spaceport seems to have a lot of visitors. Many of the usually empty landing pads are occupied, and you notice a sizable crowd at the edge of the spaceport as you step out onto its rather untarnished apron. Some members of the crowd are obviously from offworld judging by their height, and there's even a few media crews standing by, although it looks like their camera drones are struggling with Burthen's gravity.
units.italian: Grazie all'alta gravità del pianeta, Burthen non è una destinazione comune, ma oggi lo spazioporto sembra avere molti visitatori. Molte delle piattaforme di atterraggio di solito vuote sono occupate, e mentre esci sul piazzale piuttosto immacolato noti una folla consistente ai margini dello spazioporto. Alcuni della folla sono chiaramente di altri mondi, a giudicare dall'altezza, e ci sono persino alcune troupe mediatiche in attesa, anche se i loro droni-fotocamera sembrano faticare con la gravità di Burthen.

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	(See what's going on.)|725|0
units.english: (See what's going on.)
units.italian: (Vedi cosa succede.)

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	(Avoid the commotion and tend to my own business.)|726|0
units.english: (Avoid the commotion and tend to my own business.)
units.italian: (Evita la confusione e pensa ai fatti miei.)

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	Each step takes significantly more effort than you're used to, but you eventually reach the crowd. From the signs that have been put up on the way, it looks like the "Burthen Triathlon" is taking place today, and the spaceport has been designated the finishing point. A couple of especially sturdy-looking marquees have been set up; the smaller one appears to be the administration tent, currently only accessible to event staff, while the other one is far larger and is catering food and drinks for the crowd nearby.|728|0
units.english: Each step takes significantly more effort than you're used to, but you eventually reach the crowd. From the signs that have been put up on the way, it looks like the "Burthen Triathlon" is taking place today, and the spaceport has been designated the finishing point. A couple of especially sturdy-looking marquees have been set up; the smaller one appears to be the administration tent, currently only accessible to event staff, while the other one is far larger and is catering food and drinks for the crowd nearby.
units.italian: Ogni passo costa molta più fatica del solito, ma alla fine raggiungi la folla. Dai cartelli affissi lungo la strada sembra che oggi si svolga il "Triathlon di Burthen", e che lo spazioporto sia stato designato come punto d'arrivo. Sono stati montati un paio di tendoni dall'aspetto particolarmente robusto: quello più piccolo sembra il tendone dell'amministrazione, per ora accessibile solo allo staff dell'evento, mentre l'altro è molto più grande e serve cibo e bevande alla folla lì vicino.

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	(Walk over to the catering tent.)|730|0
units.english: (Walk over to the catering tent.)
units.italian: (Vai al tendone del ristoro.)

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	(Stay outside.)|731|0
units.english: (Stay outside.)
units.italian: (Resta fuori.)

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	(Return to my ship.)|733|0
units.english: (Return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	Thankfully, the walk to the catering tent is far shorter than the walk from your ship, but nevertheless you're exhausted by the time you drag your feet inside. A lot of effort has been put into this tent: the metal chairs are all sturdily-built to allow offworlders to pull themselves up, but cushioned as to not make it uncomfortable to sit in. A small firepit has been built in the middle of the tent, along with a couple fire extinguishers placed nearby, and the whole place is brightly lit in contrast to Burthen's typically chilly weather. Quite a few people, both Burthenians and offworlders, are mingling about here.|736|0
units.english: Thankfully, the walk to the catering tent is far shorter than the walk from your ship, but nevertheless you're exhausted by the time you drag your feet inside. A lot of effort has been put into this tent: the metal chairs are all sturdily-built to allow offworlders to pull themselves up, but cushioned as to not make it uncomfortable to sit in. A small firepit has been built in the middle of the tent, along with a couple fire extinguishers placed nearby, and the whole place is brightly lit in contrast to Burthen's typically chilly weather. Quite a few people, both Burthenians and offworlders, are mingling about here.
units.italian: Per fortuna la camminata fino al tendone del ristoro è molto più breve di quella dalla nave, ma arrivi comunque esausto quando ti trascini dentro. È stato fatto molto lavoro per questo tendone: le sedie di metallo sono tutte costruite robuste perché chi viene da fuori possa tirarsi su, ma imbottite per non renderle scomode. Al centro del tendone è stato costruito un piccolo braciere, con un paio di estintori sistemati lì vicino, e tutto il locale è illuminato intensamente, in contrasto con il clima di solito freddo di Burthen. Parecchie persone, sia di Burthen sia di altri mondi, si mescolano qui.

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	There's a counter in the corner with two levels, apparently so that the Burthenian attending it can serve both offworlders and locals. Alongside the typical drinks you've seen in spaceport bars and some local to the southern Core, the counter also offers a local drink called the "Antigrav" that claims to "ease visitors from Burthen's natural pull," and comes in a specially made glass, all for 30 credits.|737|0
units.english: There's a counter in the corner with two levels, apparently so that the Burthenian attending it can serve both offworlders and locals. Alongside the typical drinks you've seen in spaceport bars and some local to the southern Core, the counter also offers a local drink called the "Antigrav" that claims to "ease visitors from Burthen's natural pull," and comes in a specially made glass, all for 30 credits.
units.italian: In un angolo c'è un bancone a due livelli, evidentemente perché il burtheniano che lo serve possa servire sia quelli di fuori sia i locali. Oltre alle solite bevande che hai visto nei bar degli spazioporti e ad alcune locali del Core meridionale, il bancone offre anche una bevanda locale chiamata "Antigrav" che promette di "alleviare i visitatori dal richiamo naturale di Burthen", e arriva in un bicchiere fatto apposta, tutto per 30 crediti.

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	(Order a regular drink from the counter.)|741|0
units.english: (Order a regular drink from the counter.)
units.italian: (Ordina una bevanda normale dal bancone.)

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	(Order the Antigrav from the counter.)|742|0
units.english: (Order the Antigrav from the counter.)
units.italian: (Ordina l'Antigrav dal bancone.)

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	(Don't order anything and leave the tent.)|746|0
units.english: (Don't order anything and leave the tent.)
units.italian: (Non ordinare nulla e lascia il tendone.)

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	You hand over a couple credits for the drink and leave the tent, sipping with some difficulty as you go. The Burthenian at the counter advises you not to drink too much of it at once, and not to drop the cup "unless you want a munted foot for a few weeks."|751|0
units.english: You hand over a couple credits for the drink and leave the tent, sipping with some difficulty as you go. The Burthenian at the counter advises you not to drink too much of it at once, and not to drop the cup "unless you want a munted foot for a few weeks."
units.italian: Consegni un paio di crediti per la bevanda e lasci il tendone, sorseggiando con una certa difficoltà mentre cammini. Il burtheniano al bancone ti consiglia di non berne troppo in una volta, e di non lasciar cadere il bicchiere "a meno che tu non voglia un piede maciullato per qualche settimana".

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	It turns out the glass the Antigrav comes with has a miniature repulsor installed so that you don't need to hold it while drinking it. The drink itself is a highly carbonated soda that tastes like something in between lingonberry and raspberry, made from the native berries found in Westland, the district the spaceport is located in. The Burthenian at the counter advises you not to drink too much of it at once and to not turn it off while it's levitating, "lest it falls on your foot and we have to treat your bone fractures."|758|0
units.english: It turns out the glass the Antigrav comes with has a miniature repulsor installed so that you don't need to hold it while drinking it. The drink itself is a highly carbonated soda that tastes like something in between lingonberry and raspberry, made from the native berries found in Westland, the district the spaceport is located in. The Burthenian at the counter advises you not to drink too much of it at once and to not turn it off while it's levitating, "lest it falls on your foot and we have to treat your bone fractures."
units.italian: Si scopre che il bicchiere dell'Antigrav ha installato un repulsore miniaturizzato, così non devi tenerlo in mano mentre bevi. La bevanda in sé è una soda molto gassata che sa di qualcosa a metà fra il mirtillo rosso e il lampone, fatta con le bacche autoctone che si trovano nel Westland, il distretto in cui si trova lo spazioporto. Il burtheniano al bancone ti consiglia di non berne troppo in una volta e di non spegnerlo mentre levita, "perché non cada sul tuo piede e dobbiamo curarti le fratture".

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|label|761|0
units.english: no credits
units.italian: no credits

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	Unfortunately, it looks like all the drinks are too pricy for you.|762|0
units.english: Unfortunately, it looks like all the drinks are too pricy for you.
units.italian: Sfortunatamente, sembra che tutte le bevande siano troppo care per te.

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	(Leave the tent.)|764|0
units.english: (Leave the tent.)
units.italian: (Lascia il tendone.)

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|label|766|0
units.english: leave tent
units.italian: leave tent

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	The crowd is a bit more active when you return outside, and over the heads of the locals you see on a large, portable screen that the leading triathlete is a particularly stocky Burthenian, wearing a white helmet and tight, dark sportswear.|767|0
units.english: The crowd is a bit more active when you return outside, and over the heads of the locals you see on a large, portable screen that the leading triathlete is a particularly stocky Burthenian, wearing a white helmet and tight, dark sportswear.
units.italian: La folla è un po' più attiva quando torni fuori, e sopra le teste dei locali vedi su un grande schermo portatile che il triatleta in testa è un burtheniano particolarmente tarchiato, con un casco bianco e un abbigliamento sportivo scuro e aderente.

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	Staying outside in the oppressive gravity and the chilly temperature, you move over to the sidelines and watch the large, portable screen that is broadcasting the leading competitors from above. It appears that competitors are divided into Burthenians and offworlders, with Burthenians wearing white helmets and offworlders wearing red helmets. It's nearing the end of the whole event; the competitor in front is named Abernathy, a stocky Burthenian apparently doing his eleventh Burthen Triathlon. Meanwhile, the leading offworlder is five hundred meters behind him, a competitor from Martini named Caldarone. Apparently, they've been at it for over 11 hours, beginning with a 1.5 kilometer swim, then a 40 kilometer bicycle ride, and finally a 10 kilometer run.|771|0
units.english: Staying outside in the oppressive gravity and the chilly temperature, you move over to the sidelines and watch the large, portable screen that is broadcasting the leading competitors from above. It appears that competitors are divided into Burthenians and offworlders, with Burthenians wearing white helmets and offworlders wearing red helmets. It's nearing the end of the whole event; the competitor in front is named Abernathy, a stocky Burthenian apparently doing his eleventh Burthen Triathlon. Meanwhile, the leading offworlder is five hundred meters behind him, a competitor from Martini named Caldarone. Apparently, they've been at it for over 11 hours, beginning with a 1.5 kilometer swim, then a 40 kilometer bicycle ride, and finally a 10 kilometer run.
units.italian: Restando fuori nella gravità opprimente e nella temperatura fredda, ti sposti a bordo pista e guardi il grande schermo portatile che trasmette i concorrenti in testa dall'alto. Sembra che i concorrenti siano divisi fra burtheniani e forestieri, con i burtheniani in casco bianco e i forestieri in casco rosso. È quasi la fine dell'evento; il concorrente in testa si chiama Abernathy, un burtheniano tarchiato che sta facendo il suo undicesimo Triathlon di Burthen. Intanto il forestiero in testa è cinquecento metri dietro di lui, un concorrente di Martini di nome Caldarone. A quanto pare sono in gara da più di 11 ore, cominciando con 1,5 chilometri di nuoto, poi 40 chilometri in bicicletta e infine 10 chilometri di corsa.

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	After a couple minutes, Abernathy emerges from behind a bend, camera drones chasing him. Cheers, whoops, and rather overly enthusiastic hollers erupt from the crowd, raising enormously as he dashes through the finishing straight, the drones now circling around him. Just over the crowd a loudspeaker announces, "And here comes the winner of the Syndicate Athletics Burthen Triathlon, the world triathlete champion, competitor number fifty-eight: Samuel Abernathy!"|772|0
units.english: After a couple minutes, Abernathy emerges from behind a bend, camera drones chasing him. Cheers, whoops, and rather overly enthusiastic hollers erupt from the crowd, raising enormously as he dashes through the finishing straight, the drones now circling around him. Just over the crowd a loudspeaker announces, "And here comes the winner of the Syndicate Athletics Burthen Triathlon, the world triathlete champion, competitor number fifty-eight: Samuel Abernathy!"
units.italian: Dopo un paio di minuti Abernathy sbuca da dietro una curva, con i droni-fotocamera alle calcagna. Dalla folla erompono acclamazioni, urla e grida piuttosto entusiaste, che si alzano enormemente quando attraversa il rettilineo finale, con i droni che ora gli girano intorno. Sopra la folla un altoparlante annuncia: "Ed ecco il vincitore del Triathlon di Burthen della Syndicate Athletics, il campione mondiale di triathlon, concorrente numero cinquantotto: Samuel Abernathy!"

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|label|775|0
units.english: after tent
units.italian: after tent

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	As he nears the finish line the Burthenians' enthusiastic cheers, whoops, and hollers erupt from the crowd, and the camera drones, their repulsors now calibrated for Burthen's gravity, circle around the finishing straight. Just over the crowd a loudspeaker announces, "And here comes the winner of the Syndicate Athletics Burthen Triathlon, the world triathlete champion, competitor number fifty-eight: Samuel Abernathy!"|776|0
units.english: As he nears the finish line the Burthenians' enthusiastic cheers, whoops, and hollers erupt from the crowd, and the camera drones, their repulsors now calibrated for Burthen's gravity, circle around the finishing straight. Just over the crowd a loudspeaker announces, "And here comes the winner of the Syndicate Athletics Burthen Triathlon, the world triathlete champion, competitor number fifty-eight: Samuel Abernathy!"
units.italian: Quando si avvicina al traguardo, dalla folla erompono le acclamazioni entusiaste, le urla e le grida dei burtheniani, e i droni-fotocamera, ora con i repulsori calibrati per la gravità di Burthen, girano intorno al rettilineo finale. Sopra la folla un altoparlante annuncia: "Ed ecco il vincitore del Triathlon di Burthen della Syndicate Athletics, il campione mondiale di triathlon, concorrente numero cinquantotto: Samuel Abernathy!"

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|label|778|0
units.english: end
units.italian: end

units.id: mission:Burthen Triathlon|	Abernathy doesn't slow down until he's within an arm's length of the finishing line; as he crosses it he seizes the tape, making a yelp of simultaneous joy and relief. He holds the tape up before everybody in the crowd and at the cameras pointed at him, taking in the attention (and catching his breath) before accepting a bottle of water from someone on the sidelines.|779|0
units.english: Abernathy doesn't slow down until he's within an arm's length of the finishing line; as he crosses it he seizes the tape, making a yelp of simultaneous joy and relief. He holds the tape up before everybody in the crowd and at the cameras pointed at him, taking in the attention (and catching his breath) before accepting a bottle of water from someone on the sidelines.
units.italian: Abernathy non rallenta finché non è a un braccio dal traguardo; quando lo attraversa afferra il nastro, emettendo un guaito di gioia e sollievo insieme. Tiene il nastro in alto davanti a tutta la folla e alle telecamere puntate su di lui, assaporando l'attenzione (e riprendendo fiato) prima di accettare una bottiglia d'acqua da qualcuno a bordo pista.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|Every map of human space places Gagarin in the list of seedy, go-at-your-own-risk pirate ports which would bring to mind the likes of Greenrock's fighting pits and Freedom's gear bazaars. Still, it appears much like any other old, slightly run-down Southern spaceport, only at a much grander scale. Being the center of the planet's extensive transportation system, it seems as if you are wading through thousands of Gagarians and offworlders in every atrium and hallway of this spaceport, as they do the same to make their connections on- and off-world.|790|0
units.english: Every map of human space places Gagarin in the list of seedy, go-at-your-own-risk pirate ports which would bring to mind the likes of Greenrock's fighting pits and Freedom's gear bazaars. Still, it appears much like any other old, slightly run-down Southern spaceport, only at a much grander scale. Being the center of the planet's extensive transportation system, it seems as if you are wading through thousands of Gagarians and offworlders in every atrium and hallway of this spaceport, as they do the same to make their connections on- and off-world.
units.italian: Ogni mappa dello spazio umano mette Gagarin nella lista dei porti pirata loschi e a proprio rischio, che farebbero pensare alle fosse di combattimento di Greenrock e ai bazar di attrezzature di Freedom. Eppure appare molto simile a qualsiasi altro spazioporto vecchio e un po' malconcio del Sud, solo su scala molto più grande. Essendo il centro dell'esteso sistema di trasporti del pianeta, sembra che ti stia facendo largo tra migliaia di gagariani e forestieri in ogni atrio e corridoio di questo spazioporto, mentre loro fanno lo stesso per prendere le coincidenze dentro e fuori dal pianeta.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	But as you make your way into the central hall, you notice that, where you'd expect the greatest activity, everything has stopped. Even the ever-roving antigrav trolleys of cargo and supplies are backed up and motionless, and everybody's attention is directed at some sort of commotion in the very center of the spaceport.|791|0
units.english: But as you make your way into the central hall, you notice that, where you'd expect the greatest activity, everything has stopped. Even the ever-roving antigrav trolleys of cargo and supplies are backed up and motionless, and everybody's attention is directed at some sort of commotion in the very center of the spaceport.
units.italian: Ma mentre ti fai strada nella sala centrale, noti che dove ti aspetteresti la massima attività tutto si è fermato. Persino i carrelli a gravità zero sempre in movimento, carichi di merci e rifornimenti, sono fermi e immobili, e l'attenzione di tutti è rivolta a una specie di trambusto proprio al centro dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	(Take a look.)|793|0
units.english: (Take a look.)
units.italian: (Dai un'occhiata.)

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	(Go back to my ship.)|794|0
units.english: (Go back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna indietro alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	Stepping through the gaps within the established crowd you end up next to a spaceport gendarme. He appears as if he's meant to be on patrol duty but is too busy watching the distraction to do his job right now. Looking over the banisters beside him, you see first the enormous and oddly empty space in the middle of the hall, then a team of overalls-wearing men armed with drills and brushes. Surrounding them is a cordon of guerrillas in their rosy CCOR uniforms, sizing up the public and the spaceport security around them with their rifles and pistols.|796|0
units.english: Stepping through the gaps within the established crowd you end up next to a spaceport gendarme. He appears as if he's meant to be on patrol duty but is too busy watching the distraction to do his job right now. Looking over the banisters beside him, you see first the enormous and oddly empty space in the middle of the hall, then a team of overalls-wearing men armed with drills and brushes. Surrounding them is a cordon of guerrillas in their rosy CCOR uniforms, sizing up the public and the spaceport security around them with their rifles and pistols.
units.italian: Passando negli spazi della folla già formata finisci accanto a un gendarme dello spazioporto. Sembra che dovrebbe essere di pattuglia ma è troppo impegnato a guardare la distrazione per fare il suo lavoro in questo momento. Guardando oltre la ringhiera accanto a lui, vedi prima l'enorme e stranamente vuoto spazio al centro della sala, poi una squadra di uomini in tuta da lavoro armati di trapani e spazzole. Intorno a loro c'è un cordone di guerriglieri nelle loro uniformi CCOR color rosa, che valutano il pubblico e la sicurezza dello spazioporto intorno a loro con fucili e pistole.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	The painting guerrillas are busily finishing off the touches of what appears to be a statue of the burgundy and white emblem of the Confederated Councils, while a pile of rubble beside it suggests that a symbol of the local government once stood in its place. As they step away from the statue, a lone man in a much better-kept uniform than the others steps forward in front of their work. You can feel the air chilling as he raises his head to speak.|797|0
units.english: The painting guerrillas are busily finishing off the touches of what appears to be a statue of the burgundy and white emblem of the Confederated Councils, while a pile of rubble beside it suggests that a symbol of the local government once stood in its place. As they step away from the statue, a lone man in a much better-kept uniform than the others steps forward in front of their work. You can feel the air chilling as he raises his head to speak.
units.italian: I guerriglieri-pittori stanno finendo in fretta i ritocchi di quella che sembra una statua dell'emblema bordeaux e bianco dei Consigli Confederati, mentre un mucchio di macerie accanto suggerisce che al suo posto stava un simbolo del governo locale. Quando si scostano dalla statua, un uomo solo, in un'uniforme molto più curata di quella degli altri, fa un passo avanti davanti al loro lavoro. Senti l'aria raffreddarsi mentre alza la testa per parlare.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	(Listen in.)|799|0
units.english: (Listen in.)
units.italian: (Ascolta.)

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	(Step away before he makes his speech.)|800|0
units.english: (Step away before he makes his speech.)
units.italian: (Allontanati prima che faccia il discorso.)

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	You don't see any amplification equipment, yet his voice fills the room without effort.|802|0
units.english: You don't see any amplification equipment, yet his voice fills the room without effort.
units.italian: Non vedi nessuna attrezzatura di amplificazione, eppure la sua voce riempie la sala senza sforzo.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	"Gagarians and offworlders. Captains and travellers. Servicemen and farmers.|803|0
units.english: "Gagarians and offworlders. Captains and travellers. Servicemen and farmers.
units.italian: "Gagariani e forestieri. Capitani e viaggiatori. Militari e contadini.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	"The worlds of the Outer Rim, and indeed, those of the Republic and the entirety of humanity, have and continue to be despoiled and devastated by ruthless profiteering.|804|0
units.english: "The worlds of the Outer Rim, and indeed, those of the Republic and the entirety of humanity, have and continue to be despoiled and devastated by ruthless profiteering.
units.italian: "I mondi del Bordo Esterno, e anzi quelli della Repubblica e dell'intera umanità, sono stati e continuano a essere depredati e devastati da un profitto spietato.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	"The executives of the Syndicate and the landed gentry of the Paradise Worlds steal the efforts of tens of billions of men, women, and children, from Prime to Foundry; from Valhalla to Earth; from Bourne to Hestia, and beyond. And for near a century they have colluded to impose their designs on our worlds! The corporate insurrection in Novo Minho and the gang wars in the northern Outer Rim are an obvious extension of the arm of people like Alastair Korban, only leading to further suffering and bitter destruction in our region!|805|0
units.english: "The executives of the Syndicate and the landed gentry of the Paradise Worlds steal the efforts of tens of billions of men, women, and children, from Prime to Foundry; from Valhalla to Earth; from Bourne to Hestia, and beyond. And for near a century they have colluded to impose their designs on our worlds! The corporate insurrection in Novo Minho and the gang wars in the northern Outer Rim are an obvious extension of the arm of people like Alastair Korban, only leading to further suffering and bitter destruction in our region!
units.italian: "I dirigenti del Sindacato e la nobiltà terriera dei Mondi del Paradiso rubano il lavoro di decine di miliardi di uomini, donne e bambini, da Prime a Foundry; da Valhalla alla Terra; da Bourne a Hestia, e oltre. E per quasi un secolo hanno cospirato per imporre i loro piani sui nostri mondi! L'insurrezione aziendale di Novo Minho e le guerre tra bande nel nord del Bordo Esterno sono un'estensione evidente del braccio di gente come Alastair Korban, che porta solo a ulteriore sofferenza e amara distruzione nella nostra regione!

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	"But there is still hope. We can bring about the independence of Gagarin and unify this world that has been lost to the Syndicate-sponsored oligarchs and their cronies and puppet officials. We can reunite the Outer Rim and restore the prosperity stolen from us. We can form a new Confederated Councils and once again shine the light of Belenos across the entire galaxy!"|806|0
units.english: "But there is still hope. We can bring about the independence of Gagarin and unify this world that has been lost to the Syndicate-sponsored oligarchs and their cronies and puppet officials. We can reunite the Outer Rim and restore the prosperity stolen from us. We can form a new Confederated Councils and once again shine the light of Belenos across the entire galaxy!"
units.italian: "Ma c'è ancora speranza. Possiamo portare all'indipendenza di Gagarin e unire questo mondo perduto in mano agli oligarchi sponsorizzati dal Sindacato, ai loro accoliti e ai funzionari burattini. Possiamo riunire il Bordo Esterno e restituire la prosperità che ci è stata rubata. Possiamo formare nuovi Consigli Confederati e far brillare di nuovo la luce di Belenos su tutta la galassia!"

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	The gendarmes look around and consider the response of the crowd around them as the man finishes his speech to scattered applause. The speaker steps down and orders his guerrillas into formation before marching them out of the still crowd and into the back of a dusty, burgundy army van you hadn't noticed before, leaving the remains of the old statue scattered around the empty space.|807|0
units.english: The gendarmes look around and consider the response of the crowd around them as the man finishes his speech to scattered applause. The speaker steps down and orders his guerrillas into formation before marching them out of the still crowd and into the back of a dusty, burgundy army van you hadn't noticed before, leaving the remains of the old statue scattered around the empty space.
units.italian: I gendarmi si guardano intorno e valutano la reazione della folla intorno a loro mentre l'uomo conclude il discorso tra applausi sparsi. L'oratore scende e ordina ai suoi guerriglieri di mettersi in formazione prima di farli marciare fuori dalla folla ancora immobile e nel retro di un furgone militare bordeaux e impolverato che non avevi notato prima, lasciando i resti della vecchia statua sparsi intorno allo spazio vuoto.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	You turn around and see the gendarme you ended up next to. He meets your eyes and recognizes your off-world air.|808|0
units.english: You turn around and see the gendarme you ended up next to. He meets your eyes and recognizes your off-world air.
units.italian: Ti volti e vedi il gendarme accanto al quale eri finito. Incrocia il tuo sguardo e riconosce la tua aria da forestiero.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	"Just an everyday interruption, Captain," he says. "Only nostalgists for the old cause. We get a dozen of these incidents a month." He seems to be interrupted by a buzz from the radio receiver at his hip and strides off into the crowd, leaving you on the ledge.|809|0
units.english: "Just an everyday interruption, Captain," he says. "Only nostalgists for the old cause. We get a dozen of these incidents a month." He seems to be interrupted by a buzz from the radio receiver at his hip and strides off into the crowd, leaving you on the ledge.
units.italian: "Solo un'interruzione quotidiana, capitano", dice. "Solo nostalgici della vecchia causa. Ne abbiamo una dozzina di questi incidenti al mese." Sembra essere interrotto da un ronzio del ricevitore radio al fianco e si allontana a passi lunghi nella folla, lasciandoti sulla balaustra.

units.id: mission:CCOR Guerrilla Standoff|	Slowly but surely, the spaceport snaps out of its shock and picks up its previous momentum, although as you turn around you pass two government-branded trucks mounted with cranes, almost certainly there to carry off the newly installed statue and to clean up the mess left behind by the guerrillas.|810|0
units.english: Slowly but surely, the spaceport snaps out of its shock and picks up its previous momentum, although as you turn around you pass two government-branded trucks mounted with cranes, almost certainly there to carry off the newly installed statue and to clean up the mess left behind by the guerrillas.
units.italian: Lentamente ma in modo costante, lo spazioporto esce dallo shock e riprende lo slancio di prima, anche se voltandoti passi davanti a due camion con il marchio del governo e montati con gru, quasi certamente lì per portare via la statua appena installata e ripulire il disordine lasciato dai guerriglieri.
